eoe.text: Syr Vondam, a Solar Knight, goes to the Dawnsire's bridge with his squire Haliya, where Captain Slats prophesies that he will die in the battle, and when the Monoists attack, a newborn microvoid passes through his head.
He survives with a hole through his head, and he comes to believe that an anathema object in Sothera manipulated Slats's vision and his own death and survival to draw Alpharael to it.

Vondam declares that his judgment can no longer be trusted, but when he asks Haliya whether she could destroy all of Taro-duend, she refuses to kill innocents and persuades him to let her go instead; later he announces protocol seven, but she begs him to kill her too.

In the end Vondam stands between Haliya and the airlock, saying he acted according to the Sum except when he let her go out of love, and he pleads with her to come home, but she refuses to go home as a hero.
